socialBio: Random Pokemon Generator lets you generate Pokemon by gen, type, region, rarity, stats, forms, and more. Discover shinies, build ideas, and explore nearly 1400 Pokemon in HD.
slogan: Generate truly random Pokemon with powerful filters, shiny odds, and beautiful HD cards.
shortTagline: Random Pokemon Generator helps you instantly generate Pokemon with advanced filters, shiny settings, and detailed HD card displays.
longDescription: Random Pokemon Generator is a fully customizable Pokemon randomizer that lets users generate Pokemon by generation, region, type, rarity, stats, forms, and many other filters, with shiny odds, HD artwork, and history tracking built in.
overview: Random Pokemon Generator is a feature-rich tool for Pokemon fans who want more than a basic randomizer. Instead of giving you a completely blind result, it lets you shape the outcome with up to 27 filters, including generation, region, type, rarity, forms, growth data, and battle stats. Users can generate up to 9 Pokemon at a time, enable shiny odds, customize what appears on each card, and revisit past results through built-in history. With nearly 1400 Pokemon covered across generations and game versions, it works as both a fun discovery tool and a practical assistant for challenge runs, content planning, fan projects, and team ideation.
keyFeatures: Up to 27 filter options covering generation, region, type, rarity, forms, stats, and more.
Nearly 1400 Pokemon included across generations and multiple game versions.
Adjustable shiny probability for rare shiny encounters.
Beautiful HD Pokemon cards with rich details and customizable display options.
Built-in history that saves up to 64 past generations for quick review.
Fully responsive experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
